##############################################################################################################################
#
#  Magnetopause crossings (MPCs) identified in the Cluster spacecraft data between 2001 and 2020.
#
#  Cluster measurements retrieved from the Cluster Science Archive https://csa.esac.esa.int/csa-web/
#  via the PySpedas package https://github.com/spedas/pyspedas.
#
#  The description of the identification process using a Random Forest Classifier
#  can be found in section 2 of:
#    Grimmich, N., Plaschke, F., Escoubet, C. P., Grison, B., Archer, M. O., Nakamura, R., & Sibeck, D. G., Constantinescu, O. D. (2024).
#    The Cluster Spacecraft's View of the Motion of the High-Latitude Magnetopause.
#    Annales Geophysicae.
#
#  The columns contain:
#    column 1: MPC number
#    column 2: Identified crossing time in UT
#    column 3: Observing spacecraft (C1 or C3)
#    column 4: Prediction probability of the crossing
#    column 5: Mean value of the CIS-HIA quality flags for the plasma moment and energy flux density data around the MPC
#	       See https://www.cosmos.esa.int/web/csa/documentation for more information on the quality flags
#	       After 2014 no flags available column filled with default 2
#    column 6: Type of MPC, depending on the movement from one region to the other (either inbound or outbound)
#    column 7: AGSE X-coordinate of the observing spacecraft in Earth radii
#    column 8: AGSE Y-coordinate of the observing spacecraft in Earth radii
#    column 9: AGSE Z-coordinate of the observing spacecraft in Earth radii
#    column 10: Radial position of the observing spacecraft in Earth radii
#    column 11: Latitude postion of the observing spacecraft in degrees
#    column 12: Longitude postion of the observing spacecraft in degrees
#    column 13: Magnetic latitude (SM coordinates) position of the observing spacecraft in degrees
#    column 14: Magnetic local time of the observing spacecraft
#    column 15: Stand-off distance of the MP during the observation in Earth radii
#    column 16: Deviation of the stand-off distance from the Shue et al. (1998) model prediction in Earth radii
#
##############################################################################################################################
